sentences.en: The premier paid a formal visit to the White House.
The premier announced his intention to undertake drastic reforms in parliament.
sentences.zh: 总理宣布将在议会推行重大改革。

sentences.en: Informed of their safety, the premier breathed a sigh of relief.
sentences.zh: 得知他们的安全后，总理松了一口气。

senses.zh: 首要的，最重要的；最早的，最先的
